mapper.select: SELECT id,carry_mode,status,pool_status,pool_slots FROM t_trips WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT MIN(pool_slot_no) FROM t_orders WHERE trip_id=#{tripId} AND buyer_id=#{userId} AND pool_slot_no IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled_no_fault','cancelled_breach','closed')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_orders WHERE trip_id=#{tripId} AND pool_slot_no IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('cancelled_no_fault','cancelled_breach','closed')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_orders WHERE trip_id=#{tripId} AND pool_slot_no IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('locked','purchased','shipped','completed')
mapper.update: UPDATE t_trips SET pool_status='forming' WHERE id=#{id} AND pool_status='none'
UPDATE t_trips SET pool_status='formed' WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notifications(id,user_id,kind,title,body,created_at) SELECT UUID(),x.buyer_id,'order','拼单已成团','你参与的顺带拼单已满员成行，请按订单节点等待交付。',NOW(3) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT buyer_id FROM t_orders WHERE trip_id=#{id} AND pool_slot_no IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('locked','purchased','shipped','completed')) x
